title: A Theory of Play and Fantasy (contributions to 'The Message of Play')

verification.verification_notes: Foundational play-frame/signal theory: 'these are not the signals that they would be' — deadpan is the removal of the play signal. Presented as a 1955 volume; the essay circulated earlier (1954 Macy proceedings), which is why catalogs vary. Used as theoretical support for the withheld-play-frame claim.
